h3. What

While scrolling, the held group header is pushed off by the next group's header instead of swapping in place.

h3. Expected

S2-E1: "While the user scrolls through an expanded group, that group's header stays on screen just under the column headings. Only one group header is held at a time: when the next group's header reaches it, the next header pushes it off and takes its place. Unassigned's header works the same way (S2-R18)."

PRD: [Board View & Tech View PRD v55|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] (S2-E1, S2-R18).

h3. Actual (origin/develop, 2026-10-15)

From the code on develop: a single held header shows the group of the first row on screen and swaps in place; the next group's header slides underneath it until its first row reaches the top, then the held header changes. Please confirm on staging while fixing.

h3. How to check

* With two or more groups expanded, scroll down: the next group's header pushes the held one up and off, then is held itself.
* Scrolling back up reverses it.
* Unassigned behaves the same way.
* Only one header is held at any time.

From the PRD v54/v55 rulings on Bilal's and Slavcho's questions, 2026-10-15.
